scope: Only these five exact member paths, sizes and whole-file hashes. No generic archive, COFF, publisher or package trust.
review: All AR headers, padding, long names, both MSVC linker index encodings, every index/name-to-object binding, short import record and COFF metadata object are parsed. COFF may contain only the reviewed import descriptor/null thunk layouts and structured CodeView object/compiler metadata. All other sections, symbols, relocations, constructors, instructions, hidden byte ranges and trailing data are rejected. There are no executable code sections in these five archives.
limitations: Import metadata is not a review of the DLLs eventually loaded or generated linker code.
CodeView numeric CPU/language/compiler version fields are typed metadata; no embedded command language is interpreted or executed.
Only these exact files are cleared; no binary execution, installation, advisory or release approval is provided.
No original binary or encoded binary is committed.
